rdfs:label: movedTo
rdfs:comment: On an actor (Person, Application, Group, Organization or Service), the new identity URI it has migrated to — the forwarding address left behind on the old account.
notes: Not part of W3C ActivityStreams 2.0 / ActivityPub — a Mastodon extension (declared in Mastodon's JSON-LD context as `as:movedTo`) widely adopted across the fediverse. Forms one half of the fediverse account-migration handshake: the *old* actor sets `as:movedTo` pointing at the new identity; the *new* actor lists the old in `as:alsoKnownAs`. The old account sends a `Move` activity; receiving servers verify the new actor's `alsoKnownAs` includes the old one and move follows. Clients render the old account as redirected.

examples.title: An Actor that has migrated to a new server
